content:
h14.

**Computation site** — `memopayload.RebuildMemoPayload` in `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`. It ensures `memo.Payload` exists, calls the markdown service's single-pass extractor, and assigns `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`. The actual AST work is `(*service).ExtractAll` in `internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-422` (one `gast.Walk` over the parsed goldmark tree).

**Triggers** (all callers of `RebuildMemoPayload`, per the graph — 3 total):
- `APIV1Service.CreateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108`, after the content-length check, before insert. Comment creation goes through this same path (`CreateMemoComment` delegates to `s.CreateMemo`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:56`), so comments get payloads too.
- `APIV1Service.UpdateMemo` — `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447`, **only** when `"content"` is in `request.UpdateMask.Paths` (`memo_service.go:436-451`); the rebuilt payload is then written via `update.Payload`. Visibility/pin/other mask paths do not recompute.
- `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` — `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72`, a batch backfill (100 memos at a time) that rebuilds every memo's payload and persists it via `store.UpdateMemo`. Note: the graph reports a **certified zero** for callers of `RunOnce`, and `memopayload` appears nowhere in `server/server.go` — unlike `s3presign.NewRunner(...).RunOnce(ctx)` at `server/server.go:162-163`, this backfill runner is not currently wired into startup.

**Extracted properties** (`internal/markdown/markdown.go:371-419`, stored shape at `proto/store/memo.proto:12-21`, API shape at `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto:241,271-279`):
- `Tags` — every memo-tag AST node, deduplicated by `uniquePreserveCase` (original case kept).
- `Property.Title` — text of the first block-level child of the document if it is an H1 heading (`extractHeadingText`), otherwise empty.
- `Property.HasLink` — any `KindLink` node.
- `Property.HasCode` — any code block, fenced code block, or code span.
- `Property.HasTaskList` — any task checkbox; plus `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` when at least one checkbox is unchecked.
- `Mentions` is also produced by `ExtractAll` (lowercased, deduped) but is **not** copied into the payload by `RebuildMemoPayload`; mention resolution happens separately in `server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:34-44`.

Two related-but-different derived values, so you don't conflate them: `Property` is persisted in the memo payload (and is what `user_service_stats.go:141-153` and the `has_link`/`has_code`/`has_task_list` store filters read), whereas `Memo.Snippet` is computed fresh on every response in `convertMemoFromStoreWithCreators` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80` → `getMemoContentSnippet`, 64 chars, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-88`) and is never stored.
